name: Simplify
description: A calm Focus Mode for Spotify with word-by-word lyrics: the cover on its own, search (Ctrl+K), your library (Ctrl+B) and lyrics (L) on shortcuts, all animated. A modified version of Spicy Lyrics by Spikerko.

name: Simplify Glass
description: A slow, blurred copy of the album cover behind the whole app, with see-through panels. Built to stay light: no live blur, 20 redraws a second, pauses when Spotify is hidden.

name: Simplify Polish
description: Accent color from the album cover, a softer and rounder look, and fewer podcast rows on Home.
